# Quote card maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/quote-card/

Design a quote card with your own words, a signature and a calm color theme. Export a square, story or landscape image.

## How to use it

1. Choose your image or enter your own text.
2. Pick a layout, style or output size.
3. Create the result and download your shareable image.

## Example

Turn a short original thought into a square image for a social post or presentation.

## Limits and checks

Use up to 240 quote characters and 80 signature characters. Longer text is automatically reduced to fit the canvas.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
